purpose: Internal SECURITY DEFINER Event and Agenda creation helper; B05-B retires direct runtime EXECUTE in favor of the atomic primary Life Area-bound public wrapper.

routine.return_type: TABLE(event_ref uuid, title text, created_at timestamp with time zone, agenda_revision bigint, agenda_parts text[], replayed boolean)

state_history.current_binding: Initial create returns Agenda revision 0; later Agenda mutations are governed separately and do not rewrite the immutable create receipt snapshot.
state_history.chronology: The nested canonical Event create and initial Agenda rows commit in one transaction.
state_history.immutability_policy: Same operation/same normalized initial intent replays the original Agenda snapshot; changed intent is rejected by canonical CreateEvent idempotency.

lifecycle.delete_behavior: Routine is removed only by guarded B03-D downgrade when no Agenda truth/control state would be discarded.

obligations: reuses create_self_event rather than duplicating Event identity creation
initial Agenda order/content are atomic with Event create
legacy empty-Agenda create receipts remain replayable
create replay remains stable after later Agenda edits
runtime receives no generic Agenda write authority
